Maya C.: Weekly HelioPay account health check-in :bar_chart: quick highlights — token usage WoW +14%, QoQ +36%. Peak throughput looks good but p95 latency crept up to 370ms (+60ms WoW). Error rate 0.9% (was 0.3%) — majority 429s during Fri spike. Spend runway projected +28% QoQ. Renewal: green but recommend tight enablement.
Rohan P.: saw the Fri spike in ingress — around 10:45 UTC lots of small concurrent requests, looks like a replay from their analytics pipeline.
Liz K.: filed RINF-992 on autoscaler slow spin-up, linked logs and heatmap :mag_right: https://redwood.atlassian/browse/RINF-992
Samira (CS): what's the suggested mitigation we can share with HelioPay now? they asked for quick fixes.
Maya C.: short list we gave them: 1) enable burst pool on Dedicated, 2) increase prefix cache TTL to 45s, 3) add client-side 429 retry with exponential backoff + jitter. Also suggest rolling canary config change. snippet below:
```
# client retry example
retry_policy:
  max_retries: 5
  backoff_base_ms: 200
  backoff_multiplier: 2.0
  jitter: true
```
Rohan P.: will push an autoscaler canary tonight (ETA 23:00 PT) to pre-warm nodes faster for short spikes.
reports-bot: weekly-usage-export: https://storage.redwood/exports/helio_weekly_2012.csv :paperclip:
Liz K.: renewal lead — HelioPay is low-risk for renewal, but we should schedule a 15-min tech review to go over spike root cause & optimizations.
Samira (CS): I'll set up the enablement session Tues 10am PT and include a short config walkthrough and FAQ for retries.
Maya C.: action items: Rohan will deploy canary, Liz will schedule renewal touch, Samira will run enablement. I'll follow up with the HelioPay SOW impact if spend stays +28% QoQ. :white_check_mark:
